remediation.analysis: The route directly concatenates untrusted query parameter `name` into an HTML string and sends it via `res.send()`. If `name` contains HTML/JS payloads, they will be interpreted by the browser, enabling reflected XSS (CWE-79).
remediation.remediation_strategy: HTML-escape the untrusted `name` value before embedding it into the response HTML. Use a small local escaping function to neutralize special characters (<, >, &, ", ', `) while preserving the route behavior (still returns an <h1> greeting).
